report.summary: Checkout is serving successfully at the end of the window, but it is not untouched: its container was killed and restarted at 22:50:23Z together with almost every other container in the cluster during a kubelet/sandbox restart on node opspilot-m1-control-plane. Evidence for current health: pod checkout-6578865d87-fkvcv is Running, container ready with 1 restart, whose previous instance terminated 2026-11-24T22:50:23Z (exitCode 255, reason Unknown) and the current one started 22:50:29Z; its logs from 22:50:29Z onward show 'starting to listen on tcp: "[::]:8080"' followed by five PlaceOrder flows between 22:51:56Z and 22:54:56Z, each with 'payment went through' and 'order confirmation email sent' and no error-level line; the checkout spans sampled 22:51:56Z-22:54:56Z carry rpc.grpc.status_code 0 on PlaceOrder and on PaymentService/Charge with HTTP POST children at http.status_code 200, durations 227us-256ms; the error queries returned no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for checkout in the final sampled minutes (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET at 0.106/s and 0.228/s at 22:53:57Z and 22:54:57Z), while the only error spans in the 30m lookback belong to load-generator (GET 15.87, POST 6.10) and frontend-proxy (ingress 4.88); and over the queried window the checkout error count was about one span each on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.CartService/GetCart against 86.1 non-error spans per operation. The unusual finding is cluster-wide, not checkout-specific: node opspilot-m1-control-plane logged 'Starting kubelet.' at 22:50:25Z with pod-sandbox SandboxChanged events ('Pod sandbox changed, it will be killed and re-created') at 22:50:25-22:50:28Z, and 20 of the 22 otel-demo pods show containers that terminated at 22:50:23Z with exitCode 255 and restarted at 22:50:28Z-22:51:07Z. The user-visible errors of that minute are load-generator spans failing with 'ConnectionError ... frontend-proxy:8080 ... [Errno 111] Connection refused' at 22:50:57Z-22:51:32Z plus two frontend-proxy ingress spans with http.status_code 503, i.e. the frontend entry point's own restart gap, not checkout. Payment, checkout's dependency, looked healthy from checkout's side: 4.43 Charge calls in the last 30m all with rpc_grpc_status_code 0 and average client duration 2.66ms, and checkout endpoints (10.244.0.13:8080) and payment endpoints (10.244.0.16:8080) each have a ready address. Two limits matter: the fault-injection flags in ConfigMap flagd-config all default to 'off' (no injected checkout/payment fault is visible), and Prometheus returned dense samples only for the final ~2 minutes of the window, so the standing instruction's previous-hour comparison could not be made and the trigger of the kubelet restart is unknown. Runbook checkout-errors was fetched: step 1 (checkout error ratio) done, step 2 (Jaeger checkout error traces) returned no traces for error=true so no error text was obtained, step 3 (pod status, restarts, events) done, step 4 (downstream cart/payment/shipping/email) done via checkout client RPC metrics and spans, all grpc status 0.
